name: Cavalry Scout (Scout Archetype)
body:
Most scouts are too slow on foot to scout large open areas, or against fast-moving enemies. This is where the cavalry scout and their mount come in.

Rider (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, the cavalry scout gains a bonus to Ride checks equal to 1/2 their class level.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Mount (Ex)

Starting at 1st level, the cavalry scout gains a loyal and trusty steed. This ability functions as a cavalier’s mount using the scout’s class level as their effective druid level for determining the mount’s progression.

This ability replaces the covert finesse deed, all iterations of fast movement, uncanny dodge and improved uncanny dodge.

Mounted Scouting (Ex)

Beginning with 1st level, all deeds that affect the cavalry scout, trackless step, unhindered steps, or hide in plain sight also affect the cavalry scout’s mount. Additionally, the mount is treated as having the same number of ranks of Stealth as the cavalry scout and does not have a penalty for size, if applicable.

This ability replaces blindsense and blindsight.

Mounted Harrying (Ex)

At 4th level, the cavalry scout gains Ride-by Attack and Mounted Archery as bonus feats without meeting their prerequisites.

This ability replaces hit-and-run.

Improved Mounted Harrying (Ex)

At 9th level, the cavalry scout gains Trick Riding and Improved Mounted Archery as bonus feats without meeting their prerequisites.

This ability replaces improved hit-and-run.

Greater Mounted Harrying (Ex)

At 15th level, the cavalry scout gains Mounted Skirmisher and Greater Mounted Archery* without meeting their prerequisites.

This ability replaces greater hit-and-run.
